mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention via rate cuts, boosting equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 9.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weak aggregate demand, which triggers a policy response from the Fed, leading to positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction term has a negative or insignificant coefficient in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 93.0 over two consecutive months indicates weakening supply-side capacity, which increases the risk of deflationary pressures and prompts the Fed to ease policy, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO falls below 93.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a deepening demand slump, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and GDPC1 fails to generate positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 in a single month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals labor market weakness, which increases the likelihood of Fed rate cuts and positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS < 50000 and rising UNRATE fails to produce positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression framework.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% over three consecutive months, combined with a low federal funds rate, signals that the Fed is constrained from tightening, increasing the risk of stagflation and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term has a positive or insignificant coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 93.0 for two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side shock with labor market spillovers, which increases the probability of policy intervention and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO < 93.0 and rising UNRATE fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
